# Scripts

Maintenance scripts for agent-kit itself (same conventions the kit asks of projects).

<!-- scripts:start -->
<!-- generated by `scripts.mjs index` — edit the script headers, not this table -->

| Script | What it does | Usage | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`auth`](e2e/auth.mjs) | End-to-end test of the app template's auth flow — the built Nuxt server + real supabase-js against a fake Supabase (Auth + RPC): login, wrong password, /me, logout, throttle 429, email domain. | `node scripts/e2e/auth.mjs --app <scaffold>/apps/app   (the app must be built: npm run build -w @<name>/app)` | ✅ |
| [`live`](e2e/live.mjs) | Live smoke test in real Claude Code (headless, --plugin-dir, cheap model): plugin + skills load, SessionStart context, git guard blocks, stray-script reminder, end-of-turn checkpoint. | `node scripts/e2e/live.mjs [--model haiku] [--keep]` | ✅ |
| [`spec-flow`](e2e/spec-flow.mjs) | Live check of the lanes in real Claude Code: spec — a complex request opens a change (proposal + lint-clean EARS / Given-When-Then / ZOMBIES deltas); feature — a small behaviour tweak also updates its living spec. | `node scripts/e2e/spec-flow.mjs [--lane spec|feature|both] [--model haiku] [--keep]` | ✅ |
| [`triggers`](e2e/triggers.mjs) | Skill trigger eval in real Claude Code: one realistic prompt per agent-kit skill, checks the model loads the expected skill (headless, --plugin-dir). | `node scripts/e2e/triggers.mjs [--model haiku] [--only spec,tdd]` | ✅ |
| [`scout`](evolve/scout.mjs) | Ecosystem watch for the kit: new Claude Code versions, new hook events in the docs, template dependencies a major version behind — vs a reviewed baseline; report to stdout or the proposals inbox. | `node scripts/evolve/scout.mjs [--write] [--update-baseline]` | ✅ |
| [`bump`](release/bump.mjs) | Sets the kit version in package.json, the plugin manifest and the marketplace entry at once, regenerates the website's reference pages, and checks CHANGELOG.md has a section for it. | `node scripts/release/bump.mjs <major.minor.patch>` | ✅ |
| [`docs`](release/docs.mjs) | Website docs freshness: writes the generated reference pages (CLI, configuration, skills, hooks, scripts, changelog) from the kit's source, and checks every English page has a Spanish translation that is current (source hash) and every CLI command is explained. | `node scripts/release/docs.mjs sync | check | stamp <site/content/es/… | all>` | ✅ |
| [`repo-stats`](release/repo-stats.mjs) | Writes the website's stats.json at build time: GitHub stars and forks, and clones of the last 14 days when a token with push access is set (GitHub's traffic API needs one). The homepage shows them; stars and forks also refresh live in the browser. | `GITHUB_TOKEN=… TRAFFIC_TOKEN=… node scripts/release/repo-stats.mjs <out.json> [--repo razcue/agent-kit]` | ✅ |
| [`site-base`](release/site-base.mjs) | After `nuxt generate` for GitHub Pages: adds the base path (/agent-kit/) to the absolute same-origin URLs Docus writes without it (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.md, canonical links) and to its hard-coded favicon link — Docus 5.14 doesn't support a base path there yet. | `node scripts/release/site-base.mjs <output dir> [--origin https://razcue.github.io] [--base /agent-kit/]` | ✅ |
<!-- scripts:end -->
